name: 76182 · N Richlnd Hls, TX
findings: ZIP 76182 (N Richlnd Hls) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76182 (N Richlnd Hls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76182 (N Richlnd Hls) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
